## Review checklist

- [ ] Documentation impact is recorded above or in the commit body; affected docs are updated/created, English first with Spanish parity.
- [ ] Tagged behavior is distinguished from unreleased work; source/command evidence supports the instructions.
- [ ] Relevant build, link/fragment and translation checks passed, or exact gaps are stated.
- [ ] Fix regression protection and relevant gates are recorded; no gate was weakened.
